cluster_reason: These two base parser classes have a direct internal dependency, forming the strongest explicit cohesive relationship in the package. Moving them together preserves their base-parser collaboration and avoids separating the UTF-8 implementation from its shared parser base. The cluster has no incoming external dependencies, limiting integration risk.

blocks.goal: Move the cohesive non-blocking parser base cluster to a dedicated subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move the shared non-blocking parser base class to the destination package.
Move the UTF-8 non-blocking parser base class alongside its shared parser base.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.
